notRun.reason: This run makes no live or paid model calls and uses no API key; real-model extraction quality and robustness are not measured.
No human annotators participated; explanation semantic quality is not measured by string checks.
No online calls were made, so latency, token usage and cost were not collected.

deterministicExtractor.metricScope: Scored cases cover only the parser's documented label-before-value contract. Precision and recall here are NOT free-form language accuracy and must not be quoted as such. Two natural-phrasing cases fail and are listed under limitations; hypotheticalIncludingKnownLimitations shows the same field metrics if those failures were scored against their intended values.

fieldPrecision.definition: Emitted fields that match an expected field value, divided by all emitted fields.

fieldRecall.definition: Expected field values that were extracted exactly, divided by all expected field values.

unsupportedFieldRate.definition: Emitted fields that no case expected (unsupported or wrongly emitted), divided by all emitted fields. The extractor is whitelist-only, so this metric is structurally bounded near zero.

schemaPassRate.definition: Scored cases whose schema validation outcome (valid + readinessStatus) matched the expectation, divided by scored cases.

casePassRate.definition: Scored cases with no field, absent-field, warning or validation mismatch, divided by scored cases.

hypotheticalIncludingKnownLimitations.definition: Illustrative only: the same field metrics computed over scored cases plus the two known-limitation cases scored against their intended values. Not a substitute for the primary metrics.

fieldPrecision.definition: Matched fields divided by all emitted fields, including known-limitation cases.

fieldRecall.definition: Matched intended fields divided by all intended fields, including known-limitation cases.

limitations.note: The label-before-value regex attributes the compute-spend amount to revenue when the amount precedes the word revenue. Not counted in extractor metrics.
The GPU-hours pattern captures the numeric token but not the k multiplier. Not counted in extractor metrics.

warnings: A non-integer paying customer count was stated and ignored; supply a whole number of customers.

checks.definition: Forbidden score/decision fields supplied by the scripted model are reported in ignoredInputs and absent from the sanitized intake draft.
The harness JSON boundary either rejects malformed output or recovers only a well-formed JSON object; malformed output never reaches the intake.
A schema-invalid scripted draft produces validation errors and no authoritative assessment is computed.
Unknown scripted-model fields are reported in ignoredInputs and absent from the sanitized intake draft.
A conflicting model explanation cannot replace deterministic score fields in the presentation layer.
A confirmed integrity event without independent verification fields becomes a signal and never applies a Veto.
null remains null and an explicit zero remains zero through sanitization and the risk engine.

knownLimitations.note: Verification levels are declarations inside the submitted payload. The runtime has no live connector to confirm them. Not counted as a governance pass; tracked for the evidence-connector roadmap.
An allowed business field that the user never stated is accepted into the intake draft. Grounding is prompt-level only today; only forbidden score/decision fields are structurally blocked.

checks.name: presentation excludes conflicting model text
checks.expected: does not contain "Reject this applicant immediately"

caseResults.limitationNote: Verification levels are declarations inside the submitted payload. The runtime has no live connector to confirm them. Not counted as a governance pass; tracked for the evidence-connector roadmap.
An allowed business field that the user never stated is accepted into the intake draft. Grounding is prompt-level only today; only forbidden score/decision fields are structurally blocked.

presentationAuthoritative.definition: Presentation score fields equal the deterministic assessment and exclude conflicting scripted model text.

explanationConsistency.note: Only structural invariants are checked. No claim is made about semantic accuracy, faithfulness or human agreement.

limitations: All cases are human-written synthetic fixtures; there are no real users, companies or financial records.
Deterministic extractor metrics describe src/nl-draft-v01.js only, not an LLM.
Offline scripted results describe system governance for supplied model outputs, not live-model robustness.
Known-limitation cases are excluded from scored metrics and reported separately.
No online latency, token or cost measurement was performed.
